messages:
Maria Chen: PR opened to consolidate structured-output docs and add SDK parsing snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/419 Please review — aim to ship before next deploy. Summary: - add JSON Schema example + guardrails note - add Python/TS parsing snippets - add migration note from tool-calling. @jordan @dan @sasha

Jordan K: Reviewing now. Quick q: do we keep the old function-calling examples or mark them deprecated in place?

Dan R: I'd keep them but add a banner: Deprecated — use structured-output + schema. Also remove duplicate link in sidebar that points to old tutorial.

Sasha I: TS snippet below — uses `zod` for runtime validation + typed return.

```ts
import { z } from "zod";

const ResponseSchema = z.object({
  action: z.string(),
  params: z.object({ query: z.string().optional() })
});

const parsed = ResponseSchema.safeParse(JSON.parse(llmText));
if (!parsed.success) { throw new Error("invalid response"); }
```

Maria Chen: Nice — add a small note about failing closed-loop: don't throw in prod, fallback to parser-less path.

Jordan K: Python snippet for docs:

```py
from typing import TypedDict
import json
class Response(TypedDict):
    action: str
    params: dict
resp = json.loads(llm_text)
# quick validation
if "action" not in resp:
    # fallback
    resp = {"action":"unknown","params":{}}
```

Dan R: Also add migration note: update SDK names. Breaking change: previously `call_tool` returned raw JSON string; now returns parsed object when schema provided. Add code sample for migration.

Maria Chen: I've added a short “guardrails” admonition about max_tokens and forcing JSON output. Example:

> Use system prompt: "Respond ONLY with JSON matching the following schema" + a small sample schema. Also warn about hallucinated keys.

docs-bot: build:docs passed :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: preview available: https://deploy-preview-419--docs.redwood.ai

Sasha I: Linkfix: the "structured-output" anchor was renamed — I updated crosslinks in sidebar. Also found one broken internal link in migrations guide: docs/migration/tool-calling.md#examples -> should point to docs/migration/structured-output.md#examples

Jordan K: LGTM from me. Minor nit: change `params: dict` to `params: dict[str, str]` in Python example.

Maria Chen: Thanks — fixing those. Plan to merge after CI green and a short docs review. Targeting EOD.
